Answer their question naturally to narrow down specifically towards your target intent 'declined_card_payment'.

turns.sim_thought_process:
Target intent: declined_card_payment.  
Other cluster labels include activation issues, expiration, acceptance, delivery, linking, general card not working, fees, unrecognized payments, swallowed cards, compromised cards, disposable limits, spare cards, ordering, pending or reverted payments, and card network (Visa/Mastercard).  
I will describe a sudden failure at a merchant (“my card got rejected”) which could be interpreted as a generic “card not working” or “acceptance” issue, forcing the bot to ask for specifics (e.g., transaction details, location, time). I will then steer the clarification toward the transaction being declined, without mentioning the technical term.
